answer: Randomized deep audits with slashing. Each epoch a pseudorandom 4% of identities must open their books: verifiable compute receipts, hardware attestations, and a full funding trail. Fabrication means a 10,000 POA slashed bond, so a bot farm's expected bill is 0.04 times 10,000, roughly 400 POA per clone per epoch, and a 1,000-bot ring burns 400,000 POA before earning a cent. Auditors themselves face a second random cross-sample, so nobody holds the velvet rope. Reputation is a slow ember: it builds quietly, but one caught clone turns your whole copper hoard to ash.
